data.text:
Mohd. Saleem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Food Safety ... on 12
March, 2024
Author: Vivek Chaudhary
Bench: Vivek Chaudhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:21611-Db
Court No. - 2
Case :- Writ - C No. - 2361 of 2024
Petitioner :- Mohd. Saleem 
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Food Safety Civil Secrt. Lko. And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vijay Kumar Asthana,Rizwanul Haque Ansari,Santi 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1.  Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents. 
2. The petitioner has approached this Court for issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent no.3 to consider his application for grant clearance/NOC on the licence of the petitioner for renewal of his meat shop. 
3. Learned Counsel for petitioner submits that the grievance of the petitioner would be substantially met in case application of petitioner for the said purpose is considered and decided in a time bound manner. 
Mohd. Saleem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Food Safety ... on 12 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8780519/
1 4. Learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents has no objection to the same. 
5. In view thereof, petitioner is permitted to make a fresh detailed application/representation to respondent no.3- Superintendent of Police, District Lakhimpur Kheri, raising all his grievances,
annexing therewith all the documents in support of his claim within a period of two weeks from today along with a certified copy of this order, who shall consider and decide the same, in accordance with law, by a reasoned and speaking order within a period of two months from the date a certified copy of this order along with application/representation is placed before him. 
6. While considering the application/representation of the petitioner, the respondent no.3 - Superintendent of Police, District Lakhimpur Kheri, shall also consider the fact whether the licence is being sought for residential area as no licence can be granted for doing any commercial activity in the residential area. 
7. With the aforesaid directions, present writ petition is disposed of. 
(Om Prakash Shukla, J.) (Vivek Chaudhary, J.) Order Date :- 12.3.2024 Anand Sri./-
